newsitem.title: INDIA: India wants 8 pct GDP growth by 2000 - Chidambaram.
newsitem.headline: India wants 8 pct GDP growth by 2000 - Chidambaram.

text.p: Indian Finance Minister P. Chidambaram said on Friday that the government aims to raise annual growth of gross domestic product (GDP) to eight percent by the end of the century.
"We aim at sustaining seven percent growth and attaining eight percent growth at the end of the century," Chidambaram told a business conference in the Indian capital.
The government estimates that GDP will grow by 6.8 percent in the 1996/97 fiscal year ending on March 31, and by seven percent or more in 1997/98.
